segment: The four review remarks of the commits up to d5f6571 are recorded as statuses, with what is proved and what is not

1_late_rollback.previous_status: the late rollback was claimed as proved
1_late_rollback.the_correction: the earlier injection fired at the FIRST publication, before the marker and the stamp were touched, and fired again during the rollback, so the comparison of the unchanged metadata did not prove their restoration. The correct status was: the rewriting of the predecessor is eliminated; the late rollback still needed proof.
1_late_rollback.what_is_proved_now: the injection is ONE-SHOT and bound to a named target. It is fired at the late point - the publication of the install stamp, AFTER the marker was written - and after the refusal every watched file has its previous bytes and its previous mode, while the historical predecessor's record is untouched.
1_late_rollback.the_serving_home: not reinstalled and not touched; the check runs on the isolated bench

2_reprepare_ordinary_areas.status: NOT FULLY REPAIRED - the prohibition on running it stands
the_two_reasons: the preflight required an EXISTING access row, while the product's Onboarding.prepare() refuses such a principal with existing_principal_not_adopted and an existing home with existing_home_not_adopted. The installed product has NO repeated-preparation path, so the profile was still moved before a predictable refusal. The preflight now predicts that refusal and refuses BEFORE any move.

restore_profile() moved the archive back only when the home did not exist. A failure AFTER the product created a new home would have left the previous profile in the archive. The new home is now moved aside into the archive of the transfer and the previous profile is put back; nothing is destroyed.
2_reprepare_ordinary_areas.what_is_not_done: the access row, the binding and the access history are never deleted to get past the refusal, and the working profiles are not prepared again - the repair is a separate path and must not delay the live regression.

3_result_and_acceptance.d12_r48: kept as a separate D-12 result. The delivered archive is assessed against the ORIGINAL criteria and the assessment is stored outside the cleanable .cache: D12-ARCHIVE-ASSESSMENT.json. All five rows of the original table produced one separate letter each, every letter carries the recipient id, the name, the project and the deadline of its row, the archive holds the five letters and the source table, and the table inside the archive is byte-identical to the original input. The historical FAIL of 2026-11-03 is preserved.
3_result_and_acceptance.wrong_format_r49: the run confirms the SUCCESSFUL behaviour without the former loop: the model used the accepted format text and the file was created and verified. It does NOT exercise the unsupported_format branch or its exact answer.
3_result_and_acceptance.the_direct_evidence_of_the_branch: obtained on the checked composition itself: the installed file_tools.py is byte-identical to the V3 composition (sha256 6a20973d38e90aae2b66a07d714200b10dbe3f1f5e3b4a18c1ce2b44873e1161), and on that code write_file with format='utf-8_no_bom' returns {'success': False, 'error': 'unsupported_format', 'format': 'utf-8_no_bom', 'allowed': [...138 formats...]} with 'utf-8_no_bom' absent from the list, and the guard precedes the scope call in the source.
3_result_and_acceptance.what_stays_open: the branch is proven as a direct call on the checked composition, NOT as a model turn: the model never asked for a non-existent format in R49, so the model's behaviour on that branch is not covered by a live run. No further send was made only to improve the report.

4_tester_delta.the_correction: the description of 153 lines and the shortened digests do not replace a verifiable delta. The snapshot actually used, the installed version and a reproducible diff are now stored OUTSIDE the cleanable .cache, in the repository, with their full digests.
4_tester_delta.provenance: the installed file is the tester that was in place before this segment; the snapshot is derived from it by the changes listed in the diff. The current copy is NOT presented as the historical one without this identity: the digests above are the evidence.
4_tester_delta.no_secret: the snapshot contains no bot token; the token lives only in the tester's own configuration

status_vocabulary_used_from_now_on: code fixed - the change is in the source
bench verified - proved on the isolated bench
installed path verified - proved on the installed composition
result accepted - the acceptance criterion of the original case is met
